_comment: Canonical Starstone rank ladder. Thresholds are the CLIENT's, verbatim from MainMenuController.BattleProfileRankTier -- the game is what a player sees every day, so the token defers to it. Trainee is the one deliberate difference: the client treats it as a sub-900 rating band, but the Crest reads peak_rating, which starts at 1000 and only rises, so that band is unreachable on a token. On the Crest it means 'has not placed yet'. Ranks are absolute thresholds, never a position against other players -- a rank that moves because other people played is not a record.
